exposure: Attendance at INFOR (language-assisted birth preparation program)
outcome: Uptake of care during pregnancy, birth, and postpartum
Seeking care for decreased fetal movements
Professional language support during pregnancy and labor
cohort: 149 non-Swedish speaking migrant women who participated in the INFOR program between 2016 and 2020
finding: While the INFOR program may increase the uptake of certain aspects of maternity care among migrant women, concerns remain regarding inadequate professional interpreting services, particularly during labor and delivery.
